description: This file is a shell script designed for running memory tests and service management within a CI/CD pipeline. It manages services, executes valgrind memory checks on a specific binary, and handles output reporting.

methods.name: run_valgrind
methods.description: Executes valgrind with full leak check on the specified binary.

methods.name: run_valgrind_verbose
methods.description: Executes valgrind in verbose mode with detailed leak info.

methods.name: run_valgrind_redirect
methods.description: Runs valgrind, redirecting output to a file and also displaying it.
